title: Fit graphene Raman G and 2D peaks
query: Fit the G and 2D peaks of the provided Raman Setup output spectrum measured on a graphene sample. Determine the x0, gamma, amplitude, and offset for each peak and write the results to "/app/results.json" in the specified format, with top-level "G" and "2D" objects each containing "x0", "gamma", "amplitude", and "offset".
review_flags: The input Raman spectrum file path/name is not specified in the task.
